prediction_text: Prediction: Narendra Modi and the BJP/NDA win the 2019 Lok Sabha elections, returning Modi for a second term. Assessed 30 March 2019, before voting: incumbency momentum plus the absence of a unified opposition pole (Rahul Gandhi's Congress-led alliance trails as a challenger, not an alternative government-in-waiting) gives the incumbent alliance both the plurality and the majority path. Result declared at counting, 23 May 2019 (unit: day; counting day fixed by the calendar in the card).
